description: This dataset contains observations of the plant species *Hibbertia hypericoides*, including both the species and subspecies *H. hypericoides subsp. hypericoides* and *H. hypericoides subsp. septentrionalis*. The records are sourced from iNaturalist and include detailed taxonomic classifications, geographic coordinates, observation dates, and metadata such as identifiers, licenses, and contributors. The semantic profile highlights biodiversity-focused attributes, including taxonomic ranks, spatial data (coordinates, country, and state), temporal information (event dates, day, month, year), and attribution details (identified by, recorded by). This dataset can be used for ecological studies, species distribution modeling, conservation efforts, and research on the habitat and range of *Hibbertia hypericoides* in Western Australia.
